title: Season Runners - platformer through all seasons- browser game
author: simklever
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

we’ve just released [Season Runners](https://seasonrunners.com), an indie pixel-art Jump ’n’ Run with a seasonal twist.

🍂 **The idea is simple**:    
Every season brings a completely new game world and a new playable character. Instead of just changing the colors of the same levels, each season is designed to feel like a fresh adventure!

🏃 **What to expect**:    
🎨 Colorful pixel-art graphics    
🌍 Completely new worlds for each season    
🕹️ Fast-paced, arcade-style platforming    
🏆 A focus on chasing high scores    
🌐 Playable directly in your browser

The goal is to create a fun, pick-up-and-play experience that keeps evolving with the seasons.

I’d love to get some honest feedback from fellow gamers and indie game fans! It’s based on my son’s idea (10). ***It is fully done with Claude code.***

**Just today we release two player online mode.**

👉 **Give it a try:** [*seasonrunners.com*](https://seasonrunners.com)
